skill.summary: End-to-end Coral Cloud workflow — discover registry remote agents, compose and launch a session of agents, then monitor and close it.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Coral Cloud end-to-end workflow skill.

- Discover available registry agents and inspect details.
- Compose and submit a session payload to launch remote agents.
- Monitor session progress and manage agent lifecycle.
- Includes example scripts and payload templates for fast onboarding.
- API endpoints and command-line helpers documented step-by-step.
